svg.text: MLPerf Tiny keyword spotting (DS-CNN): 2,656,768 MACs per inference
then each output: mul, mulhsu, 6 for rounding,
uses DOT4.S8: four multiply-accumulates per instruction
no custom instruction (depthwise: four channels per word do not fit DOT4.S8)
